articles.summary: Delek Logistics reported net income of $47.4 million or $0.85 per unit, and adjusted EBITDA of $142.9 million Completed the construction of the integrated sour gas processing, treating, and handling solution at the Libby complex, successfully achieving first acid gas injection during the quarter Raising full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $530 million – $560 million, driven by strong year-to-date operational performance and including $15 million of contribution from 2026 organic growth projects On track to deliver an incremental $60 million of adjusted EBITDA in 2027 from the 2026 growth capital program Completed successful equity offering allowing for strengthening of balance sheet, decreasing leverage ratio to 3.85x Continued our consistent distribution growth with our 55th consecutive quarterly increase to $1.140/unit Delek Logistics Partners, LP (NYSE: DKL) ("Delek Logistics") today announced its financial results for the third quarter 2026. “Delek Logistics delivered
